author: Intel
description:
Intel security leader Anand Pashupathy discusses advancements in AI-driven security assurance using frontier models such as Mythos, confidential computing, and digital sovereignty, highlighting recent collaborations with Microsoft, Apple, and Google Cloud, and explaining how Intel’s hardware-based solutions enable evidence based provable security and control for enterprise and AI workloads.
